D-091-R002: tools/agent_supervisor/claude_reviewer.py: an independent Claude reviewer beside codex_reviewer.py. It reviews the same frozen head and packet, is read-only (--permission-mode plan; write-enabling modes and write/edit/resume flags refused), and refuses before any process starts when the reviewer equals the producer, the head is not frozen, or a peer/Codex review is in the packet. Its verdict reuses the Codex reviewer's ReviewOutcome/CodexDecision shape so the later combiner reads both. Malformed or empty output is FAIL/UNVERIFIED, never PASS.
